turns.content: Northstar Studio is preparing the Cedar product launch. The approved launch budget is 12800 EUR. The launch date is 14 November 2026.
Avery Miles owns launch coordination. The team will ship a guided onboarding flow and a refreshed help center.
Before release, complete the accessibility review, verify the onboarding emails, and update the help center. Jordan Reed owns the accessibility review.
The final readiness review is scheduled for 10 November 2026. Share outstanding issues in the release notes before that meeting.
Pilot customers asked for clearer setup instructions and fewer steps before their first project. The team agreed to add a short checklist to onboarding.
The help center will include a quick-start guide, an account setup walkthrough, and examples for new teams.
